recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It removes the remaining exact retired extension-name residue in current core source while leaving generic uses of ordinal value/ordinal observations unchanged because they are not references to the retired extension name. Any future wording cleanup in the Extension Pack should be handled in that repository.
issue_request: FHIR-24672 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested renaming the generic ordinalValue extension; the final approved name was itemWeight, not score, and the artifact remained an extension.
initial_application: Git commit 02d5f0bffc renamed the old core general extension source row from ordinalValue/OrdinalValue/Ordinal Value to itemWeight/ItemWeight/Item Weight. Later R5 source refactoring moved the extension definitions out of core into the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-04-27 confirm the 9-0-0 decision to keep the artifact as an extension and rename it to ItemWeight because it is not necessarily ordinal and may be decimal. Current core source already uses itemWeight in the CodeSystem concept property, Questionnaire guidance, FHIRPath weight() guidance, and example extension URLs. The Extension Pack contains active itemWeight and retired ordinalValue with a replacement pointer to itemWeight. FHIR-37508 is a later SDC/FHIRPath follow-up discovered via Zulip, but it is outside this core-source decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/observation-example-glasgow.xml so its explanatory comment says itemWeight extensions instead of ordinalValue extensions. The file is in build scope because Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the example is listed in source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-example-glasgow.xml: changed the active Glasgow example XML comment from ordinalValue extensions to itemWeight extensions.

related_jiras.note: A later SDC issue raised from the Zulip thread that mentioned FHIR-24672; it addressed ordinal()/weight() expression guidance rather than this core source mismatch.
